located_point.method: Site index point retained (Wikidata, arcminute precision; Rawat 2015 gives 23 deg 37' N, 70 deg 31' E, the same to the arcminute). The composite shows fields and two villages; the mound was not located.

sources.imagery_result: no lines: the site was not located and no plan was available to identify features

notes: No Pabumath plan was found. Indian Archaeology 1977-78 (PDF page 28) and 1980-81 (PDF page 25) describe the excavation and a large building complex with reference to a photographic plate only, and Rawat 2015 (PDF page 18) gives a coordinate and text without a plan.
unmeasurable_reason: No plan found, and the site could not be located or its architecture identified in the imagery.
